articles.summary: Planet Labs PBC (NYSE: PL), a leading provider of daily data and insights about change on Earth, today announced the successful launch of 20 satellites: the first demo mission for Google's Project Suncatcher; Tanager-2, its latest hyperspectral satellite; and 18 SuperDoves. The spacecraft were launched to orbit aboard the Transporter-18 rideshare mission with SpaceX from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. Planet has successfully made initial contact with Tanager-2, the Project Suncatcher prototype, and two SuperDoves and begun the commissioning process. Planet expects to make contact with the remaining 16 SuperDoves that will deploy on the D-Orbit ION orbital transfer vehicle on schedule. This marks Planet’s 40th successful launch and a total of 718 satellites built and delivered on orbit. articles.title: Planet Launches Suncatcher, Tanager-2, and 18 SuperDove Satellites

articles.summary: NASA CSDA to evaluate over 250,000 square kilometers of Tanager’s high-resolution hyperspectral dataset to accelerate Earth science research, following the successful launch and first light of Tanager-2 Planet Labs PBC (NYSE: PL), a leading provider of daily data and insights about change on Earth, today announced that its subsidiary, Planet Labs Federal, has been awarded an evaluation task order under NASA’s Commercial Satellite Data Acquisition ( CSDA ) program. Under the agreement, NASA will evaluate Planet’s high-resolution Tanager hyperspectral dataset to assess its quality, reliability, and utility for supporting the agency’s Earth science goals. Tanager, Planet's hyperspectral Earth-observation satellite Under the agreement, NASA will acquire Tanager data covering more than 250,000 square kilometers across both recent archive data and newly tasked coverage. articles.summary: Automated ‘tip-and-cue’ prototype will connect continuous satellite monitoring directly to high-resolution tasking for emergency responders Planet Labs GmbH , a leading provider of daily data and insights about change on Earth, today announced Planet's subsidiary Sinergise Solutions d.o.o. has been selected by the European Space Agency (ESA) to build the Slovenia Space Resilience Node (SRN). Running under ESA’s European Resilience from Space Earth Observation program under Element 2, the 12-month pilot project will develop a prototype that automates the link between wide-area satellite change detection and high-resolution imaging tasking for Slovenia's Administration for Civil Protection and Disaster Relief within the Ministry of Defence. Through this program, in partnership with software development company Lucis d.o.o., the SRN will autonomously analyze open Copernicus data and PlanetScope ® imagery. articles.summary: Planet Labs PBC (NYSE: PL), a leading provider of daily data and insights about change on Earth, today announced the successful launch of Pelican-12, an updated second generation (Gen 2) high resolution Pelican™ satellite. Pelican-12 was launched to orbit aboard the Bandwagon-5 rideshare mission with SpaceX from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida. Planet has successfully made initial contact with the satellite and has begun the process to commission the satellite and lower its orbital altitude. This successful mission marks Planet’s 25th satellite sent to orbit in 2026, across four launches. Pelican-12 reached orbit just over three months after Pelican-11, the engineering pathfinder Planet launched in July, and carries updated payload and communication systems informed by that mission.
